# awscc_applicationsignals_instrumentation_config (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::ApplicationSignals::InstrumentationConfig



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the instrumentation configuration.
- `attribute_filters` (List of Map of String) Client-side filters that target specific instances. Each object is AND-matched on keys, multiple objects are OR-matched.
- `capture_configuration` (Attributes) Specifies what to capture when the instrumentation point is hit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capture_configuration))
- `created_at` (String) The server-generated creation timestamp for this instrumentation configuration.
- `description` (String) An optional short description that explains the purpose of this instrumentation.
- `environment` (String) The environment that the service is running in.
- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp after which this configuration is no longer served. For BREAKPOINT only; defaults to 24 hours.
- `instrumentation_type` (String) Type of instrumentation: BREAKPOINT (temporary, expires after 24 hours) or PROBE (permanent, persists until deleted).
- `location` (Attributes) The location where instrumentation should be applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `location_hash` (String) A stable hash computed from the location that uniquely identifies this instrumentation point.
- `service` (String) The name of the service to instrument. This should match the service.name resource attribute reported by the application.
- `signal_type` (String) The telemetry signal type to emit for this instrumentation. The supported value is SNAPSHOT.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An optional list of key-value pairs to associate with the instrumentation configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--capture_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capture_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `code_capture` (Attributes) Defines what data to capture for code-level instrumentation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capture_configuration--code_capture))

<a id="nestedatt--capture_configuration--code_capture"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capture_configuration.code_capture`

Read-Only:

- `capture_arguments` (List of String) The function arguments to capture.
- `capture_limits` (Attributes) Safety limits that bound what is captured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capture_configuration--code_capture--capture_limits))
- `capture_locals` (List of String) The local variables to capture by name.
- `capture_return` (Boolean) Whether to capture the return value. Defaults to false.
- `capture_stack_trace` (Boolean) Whether to capture a stack trace. Defaults to true.

<a id="nestedatt--capture_configuration--code_capture--capture_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capture_configuration.code_capture.capture_limits`

Read-Only:

- `max_collection_depth` (Number) Maximum nesting depth to traverse inside collections.
- `max_collection_width` (Number) Maximum number of items to capture from any collection.
- `max_fields_per_object` (Number) Maximum number of fields to capture for any object.
- `max_hits` (Number) Maximum number of times the instrumentation point can be hit before disabled.
- `max_object_depth` (Number) Maximum depth for nested object traversal.
- `max_stack_frames` (Number) Maximum number of stack frames to capture.
- `max_stack_trace_size` (Number) Maximum total size in bytes of a captured stack trace.
- `max_string_length` (Number) Maximum length of captured string values in characters.




<a id="nestedatt--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Read-Only:

- `code_location` (Attributes) Identifies a code location to instrument. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location--code_location))

<a id="nestedatt--location--code_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location.code_location`

Read-Only:

- `class_name` (String) The class or type name that contains the method.
- `code_unit` (String) The package, module, or namespace that contains the target code.
- `file_path` (String) The source file path relative to the project or source root.
- `language` (String) The programming language for this instrumentation point.
- `line_number` (Number) The line number to instrument.
- `method_name` (String) The method or function name to instrument.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.
